mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates active monetary easing, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines relative to 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, preceding corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) relative to their 3-month moving averages signal broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% from 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% from 3-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases relative to 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.5% from the previous month signals weakening residential construction, preceding consumer spending slowdowns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines > 1.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) relative to their 3-month moving averages signal housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.8% from 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.8% from 3-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During low industrial production growth (INDPRO < 0.5% yoy), a further decline in industrial output signals imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 0.5% yoy and INDPRO declines relative to 3-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.
